summary: Bail granted by High Court to respondent in murder case involving wife's death; SC reviews bail order after witnesses turned hostile post-bail; respondent accused of conspiracy to kill wife under IPC s.302, 120B; multiple prior harassment complaints including domestic violence, assault, threats; high court held no sufficient material for conspiracy; SC examines abuse of bail concession and witness retractation; criminal antecedents noted.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)
final_judgment: Bail granted by High Court reconsidered; matter remanded to lower court with directions to ensure witness cooperation and expedite trial.
